HEADLINE_COVERAGE.reading_rule: type coverage is the breadth number and is LOW; token coverage is what determines how often the asset speaks while reading and is HIGH. Both are real; neither alone is the answer.

what_would_make_the_widening_worth_it: the widened set must hold the SAME signal on the words it adds. The rarer-677 result (0.2289 [+0.1517,+0.3014]) is evidence the norms do NOT degrade off the frequent vocabulary, but it is evidence about words that ALREADY have norms. A widened set must be re-scored on ITS OWN new words against the same floors before any of this coverage arithmetic converts into capability.
